basis: Degree-12 full-model parity retained identical outputs and loss and passed the unchanged whole-parameter gate, but rejected some coefficient bias/amplitude layer/order vectors as well as projection slices.

independent_derivatives.query_polynomial_amplitude: Sum dC*tanh(XW) over batch/time, including the frozen recipe amplitude scale (1/r! for factorial).
independent_derivatives.query_polynomial_bias: Sum dC over batch/time, including the frozen recipe coefficient parameterization scale (1/r! for factorial).

interpretation: This extends the independent oracle and attribution to the newly observed coefficient groups. It does not waive them or increase a numerical tolerance; raw parity rejections remain recorded.
selection: Union every rejected group in the supplied historical and current reports. A bias/amplitude group is a layer/order vector over all 14 heads; replay all heads at each affected layer. Other parameter families remain hard failures.
unchanged_requirements: Independent local attention 2.5% and projection5% gates
Repeat protocol: all nonembedding gradients exact, only embedding eligible for the unchanged numerical bound
Source/recipe/data/RNG binding and exact checkpoint restoration
